systems.system: National ID System / National Identity Card (Omang)
systems.tiers: national; adult coverage 90 per cent or above in the 2024 Findex survey (9 September to 3 October 2024); no digital ID for online authentication

note: A global dataset on adult identity-card ownership; for Botswana it names only the national identity system and says nothing on how births or deaths are registered.
